description: This PHP source file defines the `EmployeePersonalDetailModel` class within the OrangeHRM project. The class implements the `Normalizable` interface and uses traits to serialize employee personal details, conditionally including certain fields based on configuration settings. It constructs a model representing personal details of an employee, meant for API responses, with schema annotations for OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailModel
classes.description: Model class representing employee personal details for API serialization, including conditional fields based on system configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with employee data, setting filters and attributes for serialization, with conditional inclusion of SSN, SIN, and deprecated fields based on configuration.
